text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The first G1 race on the Tiara route
has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime showdown. The unprecedented
fatigue must have caught up with Daiwa Scarlet too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I decided to take today off.
...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's Scarlet-san and Vodka-san!
Looks like they're going head-to-head again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Vodka, do your best~!
Scarlet, don't you lose either--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No way—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I win!
That makes 8 wins out of 13 matches total!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to call it a day and take off!
No point in completely wearing ourselves out here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Hey! Hold on a minute!
I won't let you just win and run away!
choice_data_list: You should get some rest too.
You should get some rest too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm really not that tired.
So I'm telling you, I'm fine."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"That thing earlier was just her challenging me to match strides
while I was doing my morning solo training."
choice_data_list: Have you been training all morning?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, shucks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...To prevent her from doing any excessive self-training, I decided to walk her back to the dorms for the day."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're way too overprotective.
You really didn't need to do all that...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? The one over there, is that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are you really aiming for that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's why I came to you, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Please.
Please... tell me what happened.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's an unexpected combo.
And for her of all people to bow her head...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Advice from Senpai, huh... Hmm.
choice_data_list: You're taking the day off today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I get it! I said I get it already!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Air Groove-senpai is in her room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet headed back to the dorm
with quite a spirited stride for someone calling it a day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And the next day, "a certain piece of news" broke regarding the second leg of the Triple Tiara, the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"—Vodka bypasses the Yushun Himba...
...and enters the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)"!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're abandoning the Tiara route?
After competing with me so fiercely all this time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Unbelievable, running away from me like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've totally lost the mood now.
Changing direction all of a sudden like that is so uncool.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aaah, seriously... all the strength is... draining out of me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, where is this?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see... I collapsed back then, didn't I.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Daiwa Scarlet. You snuck out of the dorm recently to do solo training again, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's fortunate someone was around where you collapsed this time...
What did you think would happen if you had collapsed all alone?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You must remain calm at all times as well.
Make a wrong move, and even those who could be saved will be lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You have been entrusted with your trainee's life!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave.
...I've called my roommate to pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, my roommate...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you collapsed on the ground, honor student?
That's not very exemplary of you at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! Keep it down, will you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Still, wouldn't you say you're the one being 'uncool' right now?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You gave up on the Tiara route, didn't you?
Did you think you couldn't take first place because I'm here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right. After all, running away halfway through is just—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: DON'T MAKE FUN OF ME!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I chose the Derby
to stay true to being cool!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing this half-assed!
You don't know a damn thing about it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking, you just randomly say you're number one!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? What's that about!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn right it is!
Like, what does "becoming number one" even mean anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You just want first place?!
Then just only run in races you can win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Quit messing around!!
That's not being number one at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then what the hell is your "number one" supposed to be?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ha, so you can't even answer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Being 'number one' means nothing to you.
...It's careless, and completely hollow."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're wrong...!
My number one isn't anything like that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, Daiwa Scarlet fell silent after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biting my lip, deep in thought, as if questioning
what being "number one" means to her—
